participant_id.Description: sub-P<n>; P<n> is the subjectTag of the source release (Zenodo 19550714) and the subject label of the paper (P1-P20).

age.Description: Age in years, column "Age" of Kalinova M. et al. (2026) "Temporal order of activations and interactions during arithmetic calculations measured by intracranial electrophysiological recordings in the human brain", Scientific Reports 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0), Supplementary Information file 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx, Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details"; rows P1-P20 = source subjectTag P1-P20 = BIDS sub-P1..sub-P20. The paper Methods give the cohort summary: twenty subjects, eight females, average age 36.2 years, range 18-63 (consistent with these values).

sex.Description: Column "Gender" of Kalinova M. et al. (2026) "Temporal order of activations and interactions during arithmetic calculations measured by intracranial electrophysiological recordings in the human brain", Scientific Reports 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0), Supplementary Information file 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx, Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details"; rows P1-P20 = source subjectTag P1-P20 = BIDS sub-P1..sub-P20.

handedness.Description: Column "Handedness" of Kalinova M. et al. (2026) "Temporal order of activations and interactions during arithmetic calculations measured by intracranial electrophysiological recordings in the human brain", Scientific Reports 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0), Supplementary Information file 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx, Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details"; rows P1-P20 = source subjectTag P1-P20 = BIDS sub-P1..sub-P20.

implantation_site.Description: Implanted hemisphere(s) and region, text of column "Site of implantation (Nelectrodes/Ncontacts)" without the counts, verbatim, Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details" of Kalinova et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0; 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx). L/R = left/right.

n_electrodes.Description: Number of implanted SEEG electrodes (Nelectrodes in "Site of implantation"), Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details" of Kalinova et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0; 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx). The deposited bipolar channels come from at most this many electrodes for every subject (checked).

n_contacts.Description: Number of recording contacts implanted (Ncontacts in "Site of implantation"), Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details" of Kalinova et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0; 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx). Not the number of deposited channels (the source release keeps a bipolar subset).

epilepsy_duration.Description: Column "Epilepsy duration", Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details" of Kalinova et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0; 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx). The table does not state the unit; the values are consistent with years (always below the age).

cognitive_profile.Description: Column "Cognitive profile" (presurgical neuropsychological assessment, abridged WAIS-III battery), verbatim, Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details" of Kalinova et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0; 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx). "below-average" (P12) is printed with a hyphen in the source.

education.Description: Column "Education" (level of education), Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details" of Kalinova et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0; 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx).

task_success_rate.Description: Column "Task success rate (%)": success rate in the sequential arithmetic task, Supplementary Table T1 "Subject details" of Kalinova et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:5587, doi:10.1038/s41598-026-36122-z (CC BY 4.0; 41598_2026_36122_MOESM1_ESM.docx).
